external_network: VNN-COMP mnist_fc mnist-net_256x2 (784-256-256-10 ReLU), not trained by us

setup.property: targeted class confusion (highest non-true logit at x0)
setup.solver: Marabou 2.0 CLI on composed/base ONNX, SnC 4 workers, 120 s
setup.R4: composed ONNX z -> x0+V_d^T z -> mnist_fc; d=8; alpha in {1,2,3} sigma
setup.R3: composed ONNX z -> class-AE decoder -> mnist_fc; per-class train latent box

answers.R4_ran: YES (composed ONNX z -> x0 + V_d^T z -> mnist_fc, verified over z-box via CLI; ~35 s/query)
answers.R3_ran: YES (composed ONNX z -> class-AE decoder -> mnist_fc, verified over per-class train latent box)
answers.region_dependent_verdict_shift: YES. The tight data-conditioned local-PCA region R4@1sigma is UNSAT on 13/20 anchors, including 6 of the 11 anchors where the broad pixel ball R1@0.05 admits a class-confusion witness (SAT). The data-conditioned region removes the broad-region witness. The R4 verification rate falls monotonically as the region loosens: 13/20 UNSAT at 1sigma, 2/20 at 2sigma, 1/20 at 3sigma (analogous to the TinyTaxiNet P3 region-geometry sensitivity).
answers.witness_audit: Secondary and weak. Per-pair Lipschitz violation flags all region witnesses as off-manifold vs the real baseline (0.007): R1 0.122, R4 0.121, R3 0.319. By nearest-real L2, R1 witnesses sit near their real anchor (0.88) because they are eps-ball perturbations, while raw composed-region SAT witnesses drift farther from held-out test digits (R3 5.02, R4 5.73) and leave the unit pixel cube. The external evidence is therefore the R4 verdict shift, not a realism claim about SAT witnesses.
answers.timeouts: R4 is solver-tractable (1-3 timeouts per alpha over 20 anchors); R1 broad-ball times out on 9/20, but the data-conditioned region that carries the result is clean. R3 latent box never times out.
answers.expected_label_calibration: Unaffected; mnist_fc plumbing calibration remains 12/12 completed-match (separate §7 run); make reproduce-calibration still defaults to mnist_fc.

caveats_no_overclaim: One external network; not universal transfer.
R1 broad-ball times out on 9/20, so the broad baseline is often unresolved; the shift is established on the 11 anchors where R1 resolves plus the internal R4 alpha sweep.
Witness-audit signals are mixed, not a clean ranking; no single signal is a realism oracle.
Expected-label calibration checks solver plumbing, not region realism.
